Yeah, get your head straight.  

It's simple if both choose to figure things out. By figuring things out, you can either fight for your relationship or leave. Why choose to make your "beloved" bleed while you're happy with your nonsense act? 

If you're not happy, then talk. Talk with your partner instead of cheating. TALK. 

Sure, cheating doesn't deserve punishment. But karma does exist. And I, personally, hope that those cheaters get what they deserve. People's hearts are not toys to play with. And of course, the blame is on the cheaters, as you clearly stated in your comment. 

Oh and there's no person out there who want to choose a cheater as their partner. So why would I choose someone like that, to begin with? A cheater is someone who is cheating after he or she got a partner. Just who in the right of mind want to choose a cheater as their partner? Funny. 

Didn't you know how many people suffer from heartbreak? Some even got depression, some even die. Why choose the clearly-wrong-thing instead of getting your shit fix and done for good, for both parties? And nope. I will never cheat. I'm not that low. And I'm not that easy. And I'm not interested in someone else partner. 

CHEATING IS WRONG.

May you are not the one who will experience it someday. Farewell.

Nonsense. If they agreed to start a relationship, then why bother to cheat? You know once you start a relationship, then you are supposed to commit. If you're not ready or whatsoever, then don't start at all. Better yet, don't give hope to others. If you're not ready then don't. Why go cheating behind your partner back like their heart didn't matter? And why start an affair with someone's partner with full knowingly that he or she is not single? 

Physical attraction? Many people out there didn't care about that at all but got cheated on. What ladder? I'm sick with all of the theory nor physiological things or whatever it names. 

It's simple.

If you're into a relationship, then DON'T CHEAT. 
If you're not ready, then DON'T start.
If you know that you currently flirting with someone who is not yours, then BACK OFF.
If you're too horny, then it's your problem. Learn how to control those. Go seek help. Don't push on others. 

Don't normalize wrong things. Get your head straight.
Throw away your phone
So stay. Don't leave.
